company.name: HTTPie
company.shortDescription: HTTPie is a software development company that designs an API management platform to create testing tools.
company.description: HTTPie is a software development company that creates application programming interfaces for the creation of testing instruments. Their interface makes developing technologies, tools, and apps easy and intuitive also giving companies access to a terminal version that is easy to use and has a modern graphical user interface.

productsAndServices.description: A command-line HTTP client for testing and interacting with APIs and HTTP servers using a simple, human-friendly syntax.
productsAndServices.name: HTTPie for Terminal

productsAndServices.description: A graphical user interface version of HTTPie that provides the features of the terminal client in a web and desktop application.
productsAndServices.name: HTTPie for Web & Desktop

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered interface for interacting with APIs, enhancing the API testing and interaction experience.
productsAndServices.name: HTTPie AI

productsAndServices.description: A tool to manage installation, listing, upgrading, and uninstallation of HTTPie plugins to extend its functionality.
productsAndServices.name: HTTPie Plugin Manager

productsAndServices.description: A feature that enables persistent sessions to store and reuse HTTP headers, authentication, and cookies across multiple requests.
productsAndServices.name: HTTPie Sessions

productsAndServices.description: A system to export and import API request data, environments, collections, and workspaces in JSON format for backup, sharing, and publishing.
productsAndServices.name: HTTPie Export/Import System
